transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Delhi model muder: Accused involved in 2021 case of assault and culpable homicide. A 26-year-old man accused of killing a Delhi University student was arrested after a gunfight. The accused had been on the run since allegedly stabbing the woman to death at her home. Police teams laid a trap and apprehended the suspect following an exchange of fire. The accused allegedly fired four rounds while police returned seven shots. 1139 minutes! How defiant Sonal Dinusha denied India a 2-0 series sweep. Dinusha came with a plan and stuck to it. He made time his closest ally. The support from the other end, coupled with tactical brilliance, meant India toiled for over 86 overs but still couldn't get the result they wanted. World's first patient undergoes AI-assisted surgery to get brain tumour removed. A team of neurosurgeons in London achieved a historic milestone by performing the first-ever brain tumor removal with the help of artificial intelligence. The AI system adeptly monitored the surgical process, safeguarding essential structures within the brain. Following the landmark operation, Rhys Hibbert, the patient, remarkably regained his mobility and vision. This groundbreaking trial was generously supported by research institutes dedicated to national and technological advancement. 'It takes only 1 moment of foolishness': Ashwin's blunt warning to Rishabh Pant. Ravichandran Ashwin points out that Rishabh Pant must enhance his situational awareness on the field. While Pant's aggressive tactics have faced criticism, Ashwin asserts that adaptability is crucial for every top player. He calls on Pant, having played fifty Tests, to assume greater responsibility, suggesting that improved decision-making is key for Pant's return as a versatile all-format cricketer. Nepal floods: Whistles, shouts warned Trishuli folks as river rose 30ft in 30 mins. Whistles and shouts became the last line of warning along stretches of Trishuli and Bhote Koshi river on Wednesday as the Nepal-Tibet flood tore downstream, forcing residents to scramble up the banks while the river rose by nearly 30ft in just 30 minutes at one monitoring point. A Hawaii retreat, staff revolt, and weak AI: How Meta's 60 percent layoffs plan came apart. Meta explored cutting some teams by up to 60 percent and handing their work to AI agents under a plan code-named Project OT. Hatched at Mark Zuckerberg's Hawaii retreat, it involved two layoff waves, pods of three replacing traditional teams, and keystroke tracking to train AI models. Staff revolted, internal sentiment fell from 74 percent to 55 percent , and Meta's own data showed the AI wasn't delivering promised productivity gains. 'Don't need help': Nepal declines foreign rescue teams as flood death toll nears 500. Nepal has declined offers from several countries to deploy search and rescue teams after devastating flash floods killed at least 469 people and left hundreds missing, saying its own security agencies are capable of handling the operation. 5.1 magnitude earthquake strikes China' s Sichuan province. NEW DELHI: A magnitude 5.1 earthquake struck Longchang City in Neijiang, Sichuan province, on Friday, according to the China Earthquake Networks Center. Mountaineer for 30 years, Mumbai doctor who led tour to Nepal missing with wife. Dr Milind Chitley, an avid mountaineer and cyclist, is missing with his wife Janhavi. They were on a group tour to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra which began on August 23. Local patients and neighbours expressed shock and concern upon hearing the news. Dr Chitley is known for his adventurous spirit and community service. Nepal floods death toll rises to 469 as China warns of fresh washout threat. The death toll from the devastating flash floods along Nepal's border with Tibet has risen to 469, Nepal Police said on Friday, as rescue teams continue searching for people missing after a torrent of water, mud and debris swept through the region earlier this week.
